# Tidewater Staffing, Inc.

> A family owned staffing partner since 1992. Tidewater Staffing places trained, screened workers in ship repair, warehouse and logistics, and manufacturing across Hampton Roads, Virginia. No hiring fees for clients.

Crawling and AI use of this site is welcome. Do not follow or index the application site linked from Apply Now.
